watches.name: 1814 NORDIC MADE
watches.description: A hand-built piece of Norwegian history on the wrist. Inspired by 1814, Eidsvoll and Norway’s constitutional history. Built in only 17 pieces, with a hand-made Nordic movement and final assembly in Norway. Von Doren 1814 is not a wristwatch created for the masses. It is a time capsule and a mechanical collector’s piece, built with uncompromising dedication to traditional craftsmanship. With this pure Nordic Made project, we wanted to create more than a watch: a genuine piece of national history you can wear on your wrist.

watches.name: Runde - Vintage
watches.description: Runde - Vintage draws inspiration from the clean, distinctive timepieces of the 1950s and 60s, combined with the warm earthy tones of the Norwegian coastline, weathered coastal rocks, driftwood, and the golden hues of late summer. The copper- and salmon-colored dial, paired with a black subdial, creates depth, contrast, and a timeless, warm aesthetic. The Runde collection takes its name from the island of Runde, located just off the coast of Ålesund, Norway. The island is also known as “Treasure Island” after the discovery of gold and silver coins from the Dutch ship Akerendam, which sank off its shores in 1725. With its elegant and timeless design, Runde is created to suit any occasion. The collection is available in a variety of dial colors, each featuring a distinctive sunburst finish that changes character as it catches the light. The watch is powered by the Swiss-made Ronda 1069 quartz movement with four jewels, delivering excellent accuracy and requiring minimal maintenance.

watches.name: Norway Chess - Réti Mark II - Green
watches.description: The Réti Mark II is a tribute to the iconic chess game between Richard Réti and Savielly Tartakower, played in 1910. This game is one of the most admired in chess history – decided in just 11 moves. Not through a dramatic attack, but with strategic elegance and ice-cold precision. These 11 moves also serve as the watch’s hour markers, and the moves of both players are engraved on the case back as a lasting reminder of Réti’s masterful play. The Réti Mark II is produced in a limited edition of 150 individually numbered pieces per color variant, available with either a blue or green dial. This is the official watch of Norway Chess, designed by Von Doren, and offered in two exclusive models: Réti Mark II - Green and Réti Mark II - Blue

watches.name: Sundbåtklokka Rapp - White
watches.description: The world's oldest public transport company The Sundbåtselskapet has a long and proud history that reflects the city's development and the need for transportation across the islands in Kristiansund. In 1875, Kristiansund Dampbåtsamlag was established to transport goods and people between the islands in Kristiansund, and Sundbåten is today the world's oldest public transport company. In the year 1943-44, the Sundbåtvesen transported 2,635,900 passengers, which is still the annual record. At that time, special coins, oval tokens, were used as payment on the Sundbåten. The back of the clock is a copy of the token that was used as payment on the Sundbåten until 1951. Von Doren is proud to present this watch that is a tribute to the Sundbåten Rapp, produced in collaboration with KKS. A portion of the sale proceeds will go to the Sundbåten RAPP Association.

watches.name: Tandberg - Black
watches.description: "Possibly the coolest thing to come out of Norway.” Norwegian Financial Daily A tribute to Vebjørn Tandberg – the pioneer who put Norway on the map with his passion for perfect sound. The timepiece is inspired by his iconic Hi-Fi aesthetics and superior quality standards. The watch’s design is inspired by the aesthetics of Tandberg products: the stainless steel case is rectangular with a satin, glass-blasted finish, and a polished bezel surrounding the flat sapphire crystal. The color palette and choice of materials reflect Tandberg’s iconic products: a sleek combination of satin-finished steel and muted blue tones that highlight the watch’s minimalist design. The tip of the seconds hand, colored with red lume, moves over a blue ellipse along the edge of the dial, reminiscent of the frequency indicator on Tandberg’s TR20 series. The crown, reminiscent of a volume knob, is inlaid with onyx Limited to only 150 pieces in each color.

watches.name: GRANDMASTER MARK II, 43 mm
watches.description: Grandmaster Mark II is inspired by the enormous effort and strength required of a chess player to achieve the title Grandmaster - or Grandmaster. This unique watch is made in only 300 numbered copies. and has a steel white dial with hints of mother of pearl. The outer edge of the dial is decorated with a refined guilloché pattern and raised indices in silver. The cobalt blue, lancet-shaped hands stand as an elegant contrast to the bright dial and provide very good readability. The double-domed sapphire crystal accentuates the expression created by the elegantly curved 43 mm polished stainless steel case. On the back, you can see the self-winding movement through the sapphire crystal. The movement is an automatic STP 1-11 with 26 jewels, power reserve of 44 hours, and frequency of 28,800. The watches are numbered 001/300, 002/300 etc.

watches.name: Runde Candy - Sugar
watches.description: This elegant watch is inspired by the bird island Runde, located on the edge of the sea in Herøy, off Ålesund. The bird cliffs are the most species-rich seabird colony in all of Scandinavia, and home to around 30,000 pairs of puffins. In the past, the island hosted approximately 100,000 pairs, but due to overfishing and climate change, the population is now red-listed. This version of the Runde watch is strongly inspired by the beautiful puffin, with the case back embossed with a puffin. The watch features a classic expression with a beautiful Sugar-colored dial. The Runde Candy has raised Arabic numeral markers and a recessed seconds subdial, and comes on a specially designed perlon strap. The watch is powered by a Swiss-made Ronda 1069 6-jewel quartz movement, ensuring excellent accuracy and minimal maintenance.

watches.name: Runde - Warm yellow
watches.description: This collection is named after the bird island of Runde outside of Ålesund, Norway. Runde has the most unique and varied population of seabirds in Scandinavia, and is also known as “Treasure Island” because of findings of gold found in the shipwreck of Akerendam, a Dutch ship that sank in 1725. This elegant collection has a distinguished classic look and is available in a range of colorways and case finishes. All dials feature a sunburst effect that changes appearance after the lighting conditions around you. Runde is our entry level model and a watch that will be noticed. Runde is powered by a Swiss Made Ronda 1069 quartz movement with 6 jewels. Providing unbeatable accuracy and reliability with a minimum of maintenance.

watches.name: TREASUREMASTER - BLUE 39 mm
watches.description: Treasuremaster draws inspiration from the treasures carried by the Dutch ship Akerendam, discovered off the coast of Runde, Norway. Since the first automatic watch appeared about 50 years after the sinking of the Akerendam, the Von Doren Treasuremaster is powered by the robust Swiss hand-wound movement, the Sellita SW210-1. Treasuremaster is an exclusive and sophisticated mechanical watch, a variation of the Von Doren Runde. It has a new dial design and sapphire crystal. The caseback is embossed like a Round Coin.

watches.name: Runde Mark II - Artic Green
watches.description: Sold out Runde Mark II is a larger and upgraded edition of the popular Runde collection. The watch has sapphire crystal and an embossed back cover. The case has increased by two millimeters. The dial has a sunburst effect that gives the color Arctic Green a dynamic character that changes in accordance with the light in the surroundings. The watch is powered by a solid Swiss Made quartz movement with six jewels, which ensures precision and reliability while requiring minimal maintenance. Whatever the occasion, whether you're going to work, attending a formal event or enjoying a relaxed weekend, the Runde Mark II will be your reliable companion. The watch combines functionality with style and gives you the opportunity to keep time with elegance. This elegant clock is directly inspired by the bird island Runde, which lies majestically at the far end of the sea gap in Herøy, outside Ålesund. The island is known as the most species-rich seabird site in all of Scandinavia, and its nickname "Treasure Island" derives from the discovery of a significant silver and gold treasure from the sunken Dutch ship Akerendam in 1725. With the Runde Mark II, you not only wear a beautiful watch, but also part of Norway's rich maritime history.

watches.name: GRANDMASTER MARK II, 43 mm
watches.description: By taking a number of subtle style cues from chess, The Grandmaster Mark II pays tribute to the game that has captivated legions of followers for well over a millennium. The dial is steel white with a hint of shimmer, and the outer edge is decorated with a refined guilloché pattern as well as raised indexes in silver. Contrasted by cobalt blue lancet-shaped hands, the Grandmaster Mark II provides unbeatable readability. The Swiss Made STP 1-11 movement is visible through the caseback and is protected by a case of polished stainless steel and a double domed sapphire crystal. Delivered on an Italian handmade brown leather strap. Limited to 300 pieces. The watches are numbered 001/300, 002/300 etc.

specsRaw.Glass: Sapphire glass with 5 R coating on the inside

watches.name: Il Tempo Gigante - Brown
watches.description: Sold out. The Von Doren Il Tempo Gigante Automatisk Kronograf is inspired by Theodore Rimspoke's car "Il Tempo Gigante" from the legendary Norwegian stop-motion film "The Pinchcliffe Grand Prix" (1975). The watch's running seconds hand is based on a radar display, and the chronograph second hand is fitted with a crosshair. The hands and the chapter ring are equipped with Swiss Super-LumiNova BGW9 to ensure great readability at all hours. The movement is a La Joux-Perret Top Grade Caliber L112 column wheel based chronograph movement, and is protected by a case in brushed and polished stainless steel. Il Tempo Gigante Automatisk Kronograf is available in two color variants, black and brown, and comes in a custom oak wooden box designed in true Theodore Rimspoke style. Limited to just 150 pieces of each color.
